units.source_text: 此后源氏公子悠闲度日，时时耽于沉思，生涯甚是寂寥。

en.t: After this, Prince Genji spent his days in leisure, often lost in thought, and his life was very lonely.

units.source_text: 而无端寻花问柳，又觉没甚意味，所以足不出户。

en.t: He also felt there was little point in idly seeking out women for no reason, and so he stayed indoors.

units.source_text: 但念紫姬已完全圆满发育，轻盈袅娜，显然已届摽梅之年。

en.t: Yet he thought of how Lady Murasaki had now fully matured, graceful and slender, plainly reaching the age for marriage.

units.source_text: 源氏公子屡次以言语挑唆，但紫姬漠然不觉。

en.t: Prince Genji tried several times to hint at his feelings in words, but Lady Murasaki remained unaware and unmoved.

units.source_text: 公子寂寞无聊，天天在西殿与紫姬下棋，

en.t: Lonely and bored, the prince played board games every day with Lady Murasaki in the west wing,

units.source_text: 或做汉字偏旁游戏，借以消磨时日。

en.t: or played games with the radicals and parts of Chinese characters, using these pastimes to while away the days.

units.source_text: 紫姬心灵手巧，娇媚可爱，

en.t: Lady Murasaki was bright and skillful with her hands, charming and lovely,

units.source_text: 即在小小的游戏之中，也显示出优越的本领。

en.t: and even in small games she showed remarkable ability.

units.source_text: 已往数年之间，只当她是个可爱的孩子，并无其他用心，

en.t: For the past several years, he had regarded her only as a dear child and had harbored no other intention,
but now he found it hard to restrain himself.

units.source_text: 虽觉可怜，不免对她有所干犯。

en.t: Although he felt pity for her, he could not avoid transgressing against her.

units.source_text: 但两人一向亲昵，共起共卧，都无猜忌，

en.t: But the two had always been intimate, rising and sleeping together without suspicion,
and for that reason outsiders could not tell that anything had changed.

units.source_text: 只是有一天早晨，男的早已起床，而女的迟迟不起。

en.t: Only one morning, the man had already risen, while the woman was very late in getting up.
